result.reason: The clause includes the preferred CGL, E&O, and conditional cyber limits and requires certificates on request, but it omits workers’ compensation coverage as required by law. It therefore does not fully reach the playbook position. Requiring all coverage to continue for one year after the term also exceeds the stated playbook requirement and is not necessary, particularly for occurrence-based CGL coverage. The force majeure provision and other unrelated commercial intent are preserved.
